description: WIRE_FORMAT.md section 30: every Action arm's lowering onto the bounded program core. Each vector holds one UI action document (`action`) and the core-arm reading it lowers to (`lowersTo`), hand-authored from the section 30 table and never emitted by any host's encoder. A host decodes `action` with its own decoder, computes its own reading, and compares it STRUCTURALLY (member order-insensitive) with `lowersTo`. `arms` is the exhaustive arm set: a host whose closed action union holds an arm not listed here, or lists an arm with no vector, fails. A Confirm is the one round-trip arm: its reading also carries `answer`, the reading of what its ANSWER event lowers to (a Choose whose whenTrue is onConfirm and whose whenFalse is onCancel or the empty Sequence) - section 30.1, Phase 2106. A Dispatch is the one opaque leaf: its reading also carries `opaque`, the reason class and the name the leaf declares itself an escape with, and a reading that omits it fails - section 30.2, Phase 2194.
